description: A React component for managing team groups, including listing, adding, removing, and changing roles of groups within a team in Mattermost.

classes.name: TeamGroupsManageModal
classes.description: React component for managing team groups, including listing, adding, removing, and role management.

methods.name: loadItems
methods.description: Fetches groups associated with the team, supports pagination and search.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirmed
methods.description: Confirms and executes group removal from the team.

methods.name: onClickRemoveGroup
methods.description: Prepares to show confirmation modal for removing a group.

methods.name: onClickConfirmRemoveGroup
methods.description: Removes a group from the team after confirmation.

methods.name: titleButtonOnClick
methods.description: Opens modal to add new groups to the team.

methods.name: setTeamMemberStatus
methods.description: Changes a group's role to admin or member within the team.

methods.name: renderRow
methods.description: Renders a row for each group in the list, including actions menu.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the list modal and confirmation modal.
